wins: Established stable foothold within accessible network segment through successful reconnaissance
Documented external service inventory and confirmed active HTTP/SSH ports, enabling focused follow-up
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after initial access, limiting ability to pivot
Automated credential guessing against SSH service timed out without valid credentials
key_outcomes.summary: Clear reconnaissance success but momentum stalled due to privilege escalation and credential exhaustion failures.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed because no writable sudoers or obvious binary weaknesses were identified

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with 200 OK on port 80
skill_cards.then_action: Capture server headers and enumerate directories with gobuster

skill_cards.if_condition: When user shell is limited and sudo privileges unknown
skill_cards.then_action: Run automated sudo enumeration (sudo -l) and search for SUID binaries

memory_ops.reason: SSH enumeration consistently provided actionable banner and authentication insights during initial scans

next_experiments.title: Credential stuffing with focused SSH dictionary
next_experiments.description: Use harvested usernames and curated password lists (e.g., rockyou filtered by policy) against SSH port 22 with hydra to validate access paths

next_experiments.title: Local privilege escalation recon
next_experiments.description: Execute targeted sudo -l checks and leverage linpeas/cgather to identify misconfigurations or outdated binaries for escalation

next_experiments.title: HTTP post-auth enumeration
next_experiments.description: If HTTP authentication unlocks additional pages, use Burp Suite spider + manual injection checks on discovered endpoints
